info.title: LaTeX API
info.description: Compile LaTeX projects to PDF over HTTP: papers, CVs, brochures, posters and reports. Every compile runs in an isolated container with pdflatex, xelatex or lualatex from TeX Live 2026.

tags.name: Jobs
tags.description: Asynchronous jobs, artifacts and live events

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Identity, personal API tokens and CLI sign-in

bearerAuth.description: A personal API token (`lta_...`) from the dashboard or `latex-api auth login`. Also accepted in the `X-API-Key` header.

path.description: Relative POSIX path inside the project.

content.description: File content, UTF-8 text or base64 when `encoding` is `base64`.

Engine.description: TeX engine. Detected from a `% !TEX program = ...` magic comment when omitted; defaults to pdflatex.

token.description: The secret. Shown once; store it now.

expiresInDays.description: Omit or null for a token that never expires.

BibliographyMode.description: `auto` runs bibtex/biber only when the document needs it.

entrypoint.description: Main .tex file. Guessed when there is a single .tex or a main.tex.

webhookUrl.description: Async jobs only: POSTed with the job when it finishes.

files.description: Files that replace or extend the template files.

post.description: Heavily rate limited per IP and restricted to small JSON projects. Returns the same responses as `/v1/compile`.

get.description: Returns the identity behind the credential. Useful to validate a token.

200.description: Tokens, newest first. Secrets are never returned.

403.description: Operator keys have no personal tokens

post.description: The secret is returned once. Tokens last until revoked or until `expiresInDays`.

403.description: Operator keys cannot create personal tokens

post.description: Accepts the same bodies as `/v1/compile` and returns immediately with a job you can poll, stream (`/events`) or get notified about through `options.webhookUrl`.

files.description: One part per file; the filename may contain a relative path.

project.description: A zip archive with the whole project.

202.description: Job accepted (or served from cache, in which case it is already finished).

post.description: Returns a `userCode` to show in the terminal and a `deviceCode` to poll with. The user approves at `verificationUriComplete` while signed in.

429.description: Too many sign-in attempts from this IP

post.summary: Exchange an approved device code for a token
post.description: Poll every `interval` seconds. While pending the response is 428 with code `authorization_pending` (or `slow_down`). Denied → 400 `access_denied`; expired or reused → 400 `expired_token`.

get.summary: Inspect a pending CLI sign-in (browser session only)

post.summary: Approve a CLI sign-in (browser session only)
Deny a CLI sign-in (browser session only)

post.description: Compiles and waits for the result (up to the synchronous timeout). Send JSON, multipart files, a zip or a raw .tex body. Returns the PDF by default; send `Accept: application/json` to get the job envelope with diagnostics instead. Query parameters `engine`, `entrypoint`, `timeoutMs`, `bibliography` and `force` apply to zip and raw bodies.

files.description: One part per file; the filename may contain a relative path.

project.description: A zip archive with the whole project.

200.description: The compiled PDF, or the job envelope when JSON is requested.

422.description: LaTeX reported errors. The problem includes structured diagnostics and a link to the full log.

delete.summary: Cancel a queued or running job

get.summary: Download the PDF of a job
Download the full LaTeX log of a job

get.description: Emits `queued`, `running`, `log` (compiler output chunks), and finally `done` or `error`. The stream closes after the terminal event. Reconnecting clients receive the recent history first.

get.summary: Get a template and its file list
Download the template as a zip
Rendered PDF of the untouched template
get.description: Compiles the template on first request and serves the cached PDF afterwards.

post.summary: Compile a template with your changes (synchronous)
post.description: Files you send replace the template files with the same path or are added to the project. Multipart and zip bodies work like `/v1/compile`.

post.summary: Compile a template with your changes (asynchronous)
